page_title: MAL 1-1 RMA | Mallorca v Real Madrid 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' That was really pointless! Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) made a mindless challenge and the referee Cesar Soto Grado showed him a red card.
90+6' An attempted cross from Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is cleared.
90+4' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
90+3' It will be a substitution. Jose Copete (Mallorca) is ready to enter the pitch as Omar Mascarell walks off.
90+3' Dangerous play by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' A mistake by a defender gifts Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar.
88' Substitution. Jude Bellingham is replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
88' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Vinicius Junior will be replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
87' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
87' The game has come to an end for Daniel Carvajal. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
84' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
82' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Cesar Soto Grado no option but to blow his whistle.
81' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Dominik Greif stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
80' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
80' Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
79' Dominik Greif leaps to intercept the corner kick from Luka Modric (Real Madrid).

79' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' The referee blows for a cooling break.
75' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
74' The corner from Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is intercepted by the defence.
74' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) coming on for Sergi Darder.
72' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) replaces Takuma Asano.
71' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
71' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

70' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Dominik Greif anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
68' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
67' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
65' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) for Aurelien Tchouameni.
62' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets inside the box and tries to beat Dominik Greif with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
61' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
60' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
59' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
57' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

56' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Thibaut Courtois. This effort really didn't trouble him.
56' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

53' 1 - 1 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) jumped highest to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Daniel Rodriguez. His header was precise and ended up in the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
52' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner.
52' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee blows his whistle, Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
50' The attendance is 23010.
50' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) but poses no threat.
49' The referee blows his whistle as Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge.
48' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Referee Cesar Soto Grado has finally had enough of Jagoba Arrasate and brandishes a yellow card at him!
45+3' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) receives a yellow card!
45+2' The game is interrupted. Samu Costa (Mallorca) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
45+1' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45+1' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
44' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mallorca.
43' The resulting corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) comes to nothing.
42' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
41' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
39' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

38' Rodrygo makes a nice run and receives a pin-point long through ball from Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid). It would probably have put him one-on-one with the keeper, but one of the defenders makes a great block.
37' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
36' Real Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
34' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
32' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
30' A cooling break is underway.
29' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
27' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) launches a cross from the corner, but Thibaut Courtois is alert to thwart the effort.
27' The corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared away by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
25' Chance! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Vinicius Junior, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post.
24' Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul after Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
21' It looked like the long-range shot by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
20' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

19' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Dominik Greif makes a great save to stop his effort. Real Madrid get a corner.
18' A pass by Johan Mojica (Mallorca) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
15' Samu Costa (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Cesar Soto Grado saw the whole situation.
13' 0 - 1 Vinicius Junior finds Rodrygo (Real Madrid) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the right post. What a clinical finish to make it 0:1.
11' The corner from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Dominik Greif.
10' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).

9' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' Samu Costa (Mallorca) commits a rough foul. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and makes a call.
6' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

6' Samu Costa (Mallorca) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Thibaut Courtois easily deals with the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mallorca.
5' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
4' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
3' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
1' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends the corner into the box, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts it and averts the threat.
1' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
